notes: Catch-up sweep candidate (ad 629010). eHam SOLD tag reflects the listed asking price when marked sold, not a verified transaction price; sold_date is the ad's post date. Search '765' (sold box checked, 50 per page), first page of 10 read (back to 2012). Excluded: IC-765 ads not marked sold (576603 $675, 568948, 562436 $300 radio-only, 559345 $750 shipped), parts/part-out/cover/PA-assembly ads, wanted/trade ads, the mislabeled 'IC-765PRO III' ad 457817 (an IC-756PRO III), and unrelated hits (Dukane mic, Tenma PS, Nifty manual). Seller KD0YX sold IC-765s in 2023 (603673) and 2025 (622106) - descriptions differ, not flagged. Trigger is heavily optioned (CR-282, Inrad roofing filter, all filters, UT-30, UT-36, ceramic trimmers, MARS) and includes an SP-20 speaker.
